## Game Rules
- QuadLevel 3D Chess CID rule: The CID (Change In Distance) applies to ALL pieces including Queen and King for diagonal movements. All pieces must advance or retreat toward the opponent on diagonal moves. When changing boards (levels), pieces can only move on the Y-axis (rank axis). Movement is either X-Z (file + level) or regular X-Y (file + rank), never side-stepping on diagonals. Rook-like straight moves (non-diagonal) are exempt from CID. The Queen and King follow the same CID constraints as Bishop/Knight/Pawn on their diagonal movements.
